test.create_query: CREATE TABLE pk_tail_t1 (`c1` String, `c2` String, `c3` LowCardinality(String), `c4` String, `c5` String, `c6` Float64, `c7` Float64, `c8` String, `c9` Bool, `c10` Float64, `c11` String, `c12` DateTime64(6), `c13` DateTime64(6), `c14` String DEFAULT 'v0') ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (c1, c2, c12) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

CREATE TABLE pk_tail_t2 (`c1` String, `c2` String, `c3` Float64, `c4` Float64, `c5` Float64, `c6` Float64, `c7` DateTime64(6), `c8` DateTime64(6), `c9` String DEFAULT 'v0') ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (c1, c2, c7) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO pk_tail_t1 SELECT ['a1','a2','a3','a4'][1 + number % 4], if(number % 10 < 8, 'e1', 'e2'), if(intHash32(number) % 2 = 0, 'b1', 'b2'), toString(number), toString(intHash64(number)), 100 + (intHash32(number) % 1000) / 10., 1, 'k1', 0, 100, 'e3', toDateTime64('2026-10-19 19:00:00', 6) + toIntervalMillisecond(number * 300), toDateTime64('2026-10-19 19:00:00', 6) + toIntervalMillisecond(number * 300 + 5), if(number % 5 = 0, 'i0', 'i9') FROM numbers(400000)

INSERT INTO pk_tail_t2 SELECT ['a1','a2','a3','a4'][1 + number % 4], if(number % 100 = 0, 'e2', 'e3'), 100 + (intHash32(number) % 1000) / 10., 1, 101 + (intHash32(number) % 1000) / 10., 1, toDateTime64('2026-10-19 19:00:00', 6) + toIntervalMicrosecond(number * 1000), toDateTime64('2026-10-19 19:00:00', 6) + toIntervalMicrosecond(number * 1000 + 3000), concat('i', toString(1 + intHash32(number) % 4), repeat('z', 20)) FROM numbers(60000000)
test.query: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT c1, c3, c13, if(c3 = 'b1', max(c6), min(c6)) AS v1 FROM pk_tail_t1 WHERE (c14 = 'i9') AND (c2 = 'e1') AND (c1 IN ('a1', 'a2', 'a3')) AND (c13 >= (toDateTime64('2026-10-20 13:59:31', 3) - toIntervalSecond(66875))) GROUP BY c1, c3, c13 ), q2 AS ( SELECT c1, toStartOfInterval(c8, toIntervalSecond(1)) AS g1, argMax((toFloat64(c3) + toFloat64(c5)) / 2, c8) AS v2 FROM pk_tail_t2 WHERE (c9 = 'i9') AND (c2 = 'e3') AND (c1 IN ('a1', 'a2', 'a3')) AND (c8 >= (toDateTime64('2026-10-20 13:59:31', 3) - toIntervalSecond(66875))) AND (toFloat64(c3) > 0) GROUP BY c1, g1 ) SELECT if(q1.c13 >= toDateTime64('2026-10-20 13:59:31', 3), 'x1', 'x0') AS k1, c1, c3, count() AS n1, round(quantile(0.5)(((if(c3 = 'b1', 1, -1) * (q2.v2 - q1.v1)) / q2.v2) * 10000.), 2) AS p1, round(quantile(0.1)(((if(c3 = 'b1', 1, -1) * (q2.v2 - q1.v1)) / q2.v2) * 10000.), 2) AS p2 FROM q1 INNER JOIN q2 ON (q1.c1 = q2.c1) AND (toStartOfInterval(q1.c13, toIntervalSecond(1)) = q2.g1) GROUP BY k1, c1, c3 ORDER BY c1 ASC, c3 ASC, k1 ASC
